diagnostics.message: The secure_baseline module reads data.aws_organizations_organization.org and creates organization-scoped resources, but it does not depend on the aws_organizations_organization.org resource created alongside it. Terraform may read the organization data source before the organization exists, causing the module to fail. Add depends_on = [aws_organizations_organization.org] to the module block.

The organization configuration aggregator references the config_organization role ARN but does not depend on the aws_iam_role_policy_attachment that grants AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations. The aggregator can be created before the role policy is attached and fail to retrieve organization details. Add depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.config_organization].

CloudTrail is configured to publish to the SNS topic, but it only references the topic ARN and not the aws_sns_topic_policy that grants cloudtrail.amazonaws.com permission to publish. The trail can be created before the topic policy is in place and fail notification setup. Make sns_topic_name depend on the topic policy.

CloudTrail uses the CloudWatch delivery IAM role but does not depend on the aws_iam_role_policy that grants logs:CreateLogStream and logs:PutLogEvents. The trail can start logging before the role policy is attached, so CloudTrail cannot deliver events to CloudWatch Logs. Add depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy.cloudwatch_delivery_policy].
